verdict.rationale: Ardent documents one event-triggered behavior of its own: a connector can be configured to run SQL on every new branch after it is created. That is a rule bound to the branch-creation event. Beyond that single hook, there is no general rules or trigger engine, and per-PR branching is driven by the user's CI harness rather than Ardent rules. missing for 10: general user-defined rule/trigger configuration, multiple event types (e.g. branch delete, schema change, replication status), action types beyond SQL, detailed docs on configuring the hook, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: you can run SQL on every new branch from this connector after it is created.
